capabilities: Sync notes from a specified Apple Notes folder into the vault
Preserve images, tables, and other rich content
Configure the source folder name and the Obsidian target folder
Trigger a refresh from a sidebar button or a command
disambiguation: One-way, manual pull only; it does not push Obsidian edits back to Apple Notes or sync automatically.
extras: Works on macOS only and only via manual refresh; the manifest states it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; author accepts donations via WeChat.
problem: Obsidian cannot read notes from the macOS Apple Notes app, so notes trapped there have to be copied manually.

relations.evidence: Sync notes from a specified folder in the Apple Notes app to Obsidian

summary: One-way importer that pulls notes from a chosen Apple Notes folder on macOS into a target folder in the Obsidian vault.
